sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "genres" TEXT NULL, "origin_country" TEXT NULL, "premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "tmdb_rating" TEXT NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "is_in_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_in_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "is_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_watched" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "watchlist_added_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_watched_at" INTEGER NULL, "localized_title" TEXT NULL, "localized_poster_url" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "genres" TEXT NULL, "origin_country" TEXT NULL, "premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "tmdb_rating" TEXT NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "is_in_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_in_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "is_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_watched" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "watchlist_added_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_watched_at" INTEGER NULL, "localized_title" TEXT NULL, "localized_poster_url" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_user_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "movies_synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "series_synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "is_first_launch" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_first_launch" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watched" IN (0, 1)), "include_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "from_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watched" IN (0, 1)), "include_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "from_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies_events_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES movies_table(tmdb_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_events_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES series_table(tmdb_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NULL, "user_rating" INTEGER NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watched_movies_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "from_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "from_watched_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_watched_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watched_series_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watchlist" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watchlist" IN (0, 1)), "from_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "from_watched_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_watched_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlist_movies_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watched" IN (0, 1)), "from_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "from_added_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_added_date" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlist_series_filter_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sort_by" TEXT NULL, "with_countries" TEXT NULL, "with_genres" TEXT NULL, "without_genres" TEXT NULL, "include_watched" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("include_watched" IN (0, 1)), "from_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_premiere_date" INTEGER NULL, "from_added_date" INTEGER NULL, "to_added_date" INTEGER NULL);
